name: Engraved Copper Stethoscope ID Tag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from high-quality copper, this engraved stethoscope ID tag is designed for durability, lightweight comfort, and long-lasting daily use. 

- The smooth polished finish resists wear while maintaining a professional appearance. 

- Available in elegant Silver, Gold, and Rose Gold finishes, each tag securely wraps around most standard stethoscope tubing without affecting performance or comfort.

- Available with an optional charm attachment for added personalization and style.

- Comes with a premium gift box

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed to fit securely on most stethoscope tubes while remaining compact and lightweight:

Style 1

- Width: 0.59 in (1.5 cm )

- Height:  0.51 in (1.3 cm)

Style 2

- Width:  0.59 in (1.5 cm)

- Height:  0.9 in (2.3 cm)

 

  • Engraving Technology

- Personalized using precision laser engraving technology that creates a permanent, crisp, and highly detailed finish. 

- Perfect for displaying names, initials, credentials, or custom text for easy identification.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

- Perfect for nurses, doctors, medical students, veterinarians, EMTs, and other healthcare professionals, helping prevent stethoscope mix-ups in hospitals, clinics, laboratories, and shared workspaces.
- The easy-to-install design allows the tag to be attached by simply sliding it onto the stethoscope tubing. 

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized engraved copper stethoscope ID tag makes a thoughtful and practical gift for healthcare professionals at every stage of their career. Ideal for nursing school graduations, medical school graduations, Nurse Appreciation Week, birthdays, Christmas, employee recognition gifts, work anniversaries, and other special occasions. 

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 5-7 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Engraved Copper Stethoscope ID Tag and a premium gift box

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • For orders with charm, please make sure to include the charm code in the Note column when submitting the order.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
